<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—a strong M peak at 183 Da, a clear M+1 peak (≈13 C) and an M+2 peak at 185 Da with intensity about one‑third of the M peak (characteristic of chlorine’s 35/37 isotopic ratio)—the elements that can be definitively identified are carbon and chlorine.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'Cl']</final_answer>
